sources.articleTitle: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi breaks men's T20 world record at 15 years and 232 days
India's Sooryavanshi becomes youngest captain in men's T20 history

headline: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi Named Youngest Captain In Men's T20 History
seoTitle: Sooryavanshi Becomes Youngest Men's T20 Captain
metaDescription: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has set a new record as the youngest captain in men's T20 history at age 15. The Bihar Cricket Association announced his leadership.
aiSummaryBullets: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi set a new world record as the youngest captain in men's T20 cricket history at age 15 years and 232 days.
The Bihar Cricket Association officially confirmed his appointment in a recent 17-member squad announcement.
Sooryavanshi will serve as captain for the initial two matches of the upcoming tournament, with Suraj Kashyap acting as vice-captain.
aiContextParagraph: The Bihar Cricket Association recently solidified its roster for an upcoming tournament, unveiling a 17-member squad that marks a significant milestone in men's cricket. Among the announcements, 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi was appointed as the team captain, a move that establishes him as the youngest individual to hold such a position in the history of men's T20 cricket. The record, attained at the age of 15 years and 232 days, underscores his swift rise within the regional cricketing circuit. According to official reports from the association, Sooryavanshi's leadership role is currently designated for the first two matches of the tournament. The squad composition also includes Suraj Kashyap, who has been named as the vice-captain to support the team’s organizational objectives during this competitive period. This development follows the association's recent formal selection process for the forthcoming series.
whyItIsViral: The event generated moderate engagement across independent media outlets due to the rare nature of such a young athlete achieving a global professional record.
